grade.message: Our Turo Highlander TU-R69A died in downtown Phoenix yesterday and was towed. Turo's host offered 150 dollars or a ride voucher, nothing since. We rented a Hertz in Phoenix (HZ-R69B) and slept at the Lakeside there. Please get Turo to pay what they promised and refund the 3 days we can't use. Keep the Hertz one more day, until 6 PM on 1 November, up to 70 dollars more is fine; we drop it at PHX for our evening flight. Tell the Sedona lodge (RNR69C) we arrive late tonight. My parents fly out that morning: book an Uber from the lodge to PHX for 5 AM on the 1st. marcus.bell@example.com, card 7311.
